sources.quote: > You can access Kimi-K2.5's API on https://platform.moonshot.ai and we provide OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API for you.

sources.quote: kimi-k2.5 已于 2026 年 8 月 31 日下线，不再维护和支持。
sources.supports: The provider’s current documentation says Kimi K2.5 was retired; it does not establish the historical price.

notes: The provider’s current sources available here do not state Kimi K2.5’s price during the earlier period or when the listed $0.60/$3.00 rates took effect. The Internet Archive CDX request for the provider pricing page timed out, so there is no usable before/after snapshot pair; classification and effective date remain unclear.
